summaries.zoomrx-ai-native-backend: Software engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Python, agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and backend platform engineering, building with Claude Code and the OpenAI Agents SDK as a default workflow rather than a novelty. Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill that automated refactoring, testing, and deployment at Turbot HQ, using it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven architecture and cut resource-discovery latency 70–90%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation — building with agentic tooling as a default workflow, not an experiment; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python — one of 120+ merged pull requests across Turbot's four open-source products (9,300+ combined GitHub stars) — giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent to resolve cross-team queries by ingesting the documentation and code graph for all internal repos into AWS S3 vector storage; deployed it to AWS Lambda and integrated it with the Slack Bot API as the UI for instant, context-aware query resolution.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% (cutting report generation from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ resources) and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.
